name: Many-faced Killer (CR 12)
body:
MANY-FACED KILLER
CR 12

XP 19,200
Human rogue 5/assassin (many-faced killer) 8
N Medium humanoid (human)
Init +7; Senses Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+5 armor, +1 deflection, +3 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 88 (13d8+26)
Fort +6, Ref +11, Will +5; +4 vs. divination
Defensive Abilities evasion, trap sense +1, uncanny dodge

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 glamered shortsword +13/+8 (1d6+1/19-20)
Ranged +1 sling +13 (1d4)
Special Attacks death attack (DC 21), sneak attack +7d6

TACTICS

Before Combat The many-faced killer attempts to get close to her intended target using her abilities of disguise or stealth if necessary.

During Combat The many-faced killer uses a death attack, if possible, and feints her opponent in order to get in sneak attacks.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 12, Int 16, Wis 8, Cha 14
Base Atk +9; CMB +9; CMD 22
Feats Combat Expertise, Deceitful, Extra Assassin Talent*, Improved Feint, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Vital Strike, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +16, Bluff +19, Climb +11, Disable Device +12, Disguise +19, Escape Artist +16, Knowledge (local) +16, Perception +12, Sense Motive +12, Sleight of Hand +13, Stealth +16, Use Magic Device +15
Languages Common, Dwarven, Elven, Halfling
SQ assassin talents (another face in the crowd, lost in the crowd, quick comeback), art of deception +8, hidden weapons, many faces, master of disguise, quick change, rogue talents (fast stealth, resiliency, surprise attack), shift alignment, superficial knowledge, trapfinding
Gear potion of cure light wounds (2), potion of see invisibility, wand of true strike (45 charges); Other Gear +1 glamered shortsword, +1 sling and 10 bullets, +1 glamered mithral chain, amulet of natural armor +1, eyes of the owl, gloves of larceny, ring of protection +1, disguise kit, masterwork thieves’ tools, reversible cloak, scholar’s outfit, tear-away peasant’s outfit, 197 gp
